title: Gleamdance Dagger

sources.title: Gleamdance Dagger: Glowing
markers: | description = This object shines with a glowing light in a radius of {{Radius|m=6|ft=20}}.

sources.title: Gleamdancer
markers: | description = When this dagger is wielded in the off-hand, the wielder gains a +1 bonus to {{Armour Class}}.

summary: A +2 dagger that can shed light and gives +1 AC when held in the off hand.

fields.Glow: Toggle the light on or off. It illuminates a 20 ft radius.
fields.Gleamdancer: Wield in the off hand to gain +1 AC.
fields.Base value: 190 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
